connectionRoutes.notes: WSDL-defined connector invocation; production, test and sandbox endpoint patterns are provider-documented.
Configuration Manager supports scheduled connector subscriptions against customer-managed SFTP endpoints.
Configuration Manager exposes OData as an endpoint category; exact objects and auth remain tenant-specific until authenticated proof.

patch.readCapability: Provider supports download connectors over web services and subscription/file routes. WFM remains read-only.
patch.writeCapability: Provider supports upload connectors, including time-sheet and work-order mutations, but all Fieldglass mutations remain disabled in WFM.
patch.freshnessLatency: Connector/schedule dependent. Delta worker downloads can use provider-maintained Last Run Date/history; subscriptions may be scheduled multiple times depending customer configuration.
permissions: Company integration setting must be enabled for the chosen connector.
User role requires Upload Data / Download Data permissions where documented.
Dedicated least-privilege integration identity required before authentication evidence can advance.

paginationDeltaEventsFilesQueues.pagination: Batch connector semantics rather than one universal page contract; verify per connector.
paginationDeltaEventsFilesQueues.delta: Some downloads are delta/last-run based and can use selected Delta Compare fields/history.
paginationDeltaEventsFilesQueues.events: Publish/Subscribe is a Configuration Manager endpoint category but is not treated as a proven exactly-once event source.
paginationDeltaEventsFilesQueues.files: CSV/XML and connector-specific formats over web service or SFTP subscription.

patch.customFields: Download connectors can include customer-selected custom fields, often appended after native columns; schema fingerprint must therefore be connector-and-tenant scoped.
patch.regionalApiVersions: Endpoints are data-centre specific. Connector versions include API, API-A, BULK and DELTA variants depending connector; preserve company, datacentre, connector and version in lineage/checkpoints.
patch.rateLimits: No single public universal rate-limit contract verified; measure in authorised tenant and obey connector-specific limits.
failureModes: web-service transport succeeds but asynchronous upload processing later fails at record level
missed or partial file while provider Last Run Date advances
duplicate or multi-row worker records across cost centre/task/rate dimensions
stale delta-history or reset/truncation causing replay/full download
patch.reconciliation: Maintain a WFM-owned run manifest, checksum/schema evidence, scoped watermark and overlap/backfill policy. Never advance a watermark on partial/corrupt transfer and never infer deletion from a delta feed.
patch.schemaDrift: Fingerprint each connector/version/custom-field layout; quarantine incompatible column/type drift until remapped.
patch.retriesReconnect: Retry read/download operations idempotently with bounded backoff; preserve prior watermark until integrity/reconciliation completes.
patch.evidenceNote: SAP documents Fieldglass WSDL web-service connector invocation, username/license-key auth, production/test/sandbox endpoints, SFTP and OData endpoint categories, delta worker downloads, custom fields and connector-specific permissions. No sandbox or tenant authentication has been performed.

customerValue: compare planned versus approved contingent hours and rates
detect supplier/rate/time exceptions before payroll or invoice reconciliation
accelerate contingent-worker onboarding/offboarding and site allocation

patch.causalOutcomeReadiness: Preserve worker/work-order/supplier/time-sheet identifiers plus effective timestamps so recommendations about agency reduction can later be compared with staffing, overtime, throughput and cost outcomes without treating correlation as causation.
patch.nextBuildAction: Use an authorised Fieldglass test/sandbox tenant to prove a download-only connector identity, real worker/work-order/time-sheet reads, delta replay, custom-field drift, datacentre scoping and failed-transfer recovery; keep all uploads denied.
